card.name: Article after apply in topical directions
card.fires_on: The word "a" (or the space) right after "apply" or "use" in directions for skin products, just before "thin layer" or an amount.

modes.label: "a" after apply
modes.description: The article "a" directly after apply/use, leading into thin layer, pea-sized amount or single application.
modes.example: For psoriasis, apply<< a>> thin layer of fluocinonide

modes.label: Space after apply before a number
modes.description: The blank space after apply, just before a quantity such as 2.5 grams.

card.plain: It marks the spot after "apply" in skin-product directions where an amount such as "a thin layer" comes next.
